7.2 Error Hooks
To support debugging and error tracing during development and runtime, the Default
Error Tracer provides functionality for notification of received error reports. Therefore
so called error hooks are configurable. The error hooks will be used to forward error
notifications. If at least one error hook has been configured, the Default Error Tracer
will notify each received error report by calling the configured error hook(s).
Configuration of error hooks is done by the AUTOSAR configuration methods described
in chapter 10.
